ayahs.arabic: ٱقۡتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ مُّعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.translit: Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin muAAridoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away

ayahs.arabic: مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرࣲ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسۡتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istamaAAoohu wahum yalAAaboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play

ayahs.arabic: لَاهِيَةࣰ قُلُوبُهُمۡۗ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ هَلۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُكُمۡۖ أَفَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلسِّحۡرَ وَأَنتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbee yaAAlamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ أَضۡغَٰثُ أَحۡلَٰمِۭ بَلِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ بَلۡ هُوَ شَاعِرࣱ فَلۡيَأۡتِنَا بِـَٔايَةࣲ كَمَآ أُرۡسِلَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa shaAAirun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]

ayahs.arabic: مَآ ءَامَنَتۡ قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآۖ أَفَهُمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالࣰ ا نُّوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡۖ فَسۡـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهۡلَ ٱلذِّكۡرِ إِن كُنتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ جَسَدࣰ ا لَّا يَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُواْ خَٰلِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama jaAAalnahum jasadan la yakuloona alttaAAama wama kanoo khalideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth]

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡوَعۡدَ فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُمۡ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهۡلَكۡنَا ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
ayahs.translit: Thumma sadaqnahumu alwaAAda faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ كِتَٰبࣰ ا فِيهِ ذِكۡرُكُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala taAAqiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةࣲ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةࣰ وَأَنشَأۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana baAAdaha qawman akhareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّواْ بَأۡسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَرۡكُضُونَ
ayahs.translit: Falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it

ayahs.arabic: لَا تَرۡكُضُواْ وَٱرۡجِعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتۡرِفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.translit: La tarkudoo wairjiAAoo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum laAAallakum tusaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوَىٰهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fama zalat tilka daAAwahum hatta jaAAalnahum haseedan khamideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire]

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play

ayahs.arabic: لَوۡ أَرَدۡنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهۡوࣰ ا لَّٱتَّخَذۡنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna faAAileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلۡبَٰطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقࣱۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
ayahs.translit: Bal naqthifu bialhaqqi AAala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسۡتَحۡسِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman AAindahu la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wala yastahsiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire

ayahs.arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفۡتُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken

ayahs.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَالِهَةࣰ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هُمۡ يُنشِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]

ayahs.arabic: لَوۡ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَاۚ فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.translit: Law kana feehima alihatun illa Allahu lafasadata fasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe

ayahs.arabic: لَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفۡعَلُ وَهُمۡ يُسۡـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.translit: La yusalu AAamma yafAAalu wahum yusaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned

ayahs.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةࣰۖ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡۖ هَٰذَا ذِكۡرُ مَن مَّعِيَ وَذِكۡرُ مَن قَبۡلِيۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ فَهُم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan qul hatoo burhanakum hatha thikru man maAAiya wathikru man qablee bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona alhaqqa fahum muAAridoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ
ayahs.translit: Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin illa noohee ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدࣰ اۗ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۚ بَلۡ عِبَادࣱ مُّكۡرَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan subhanahu bal AAibadun mukramoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَسۡبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَهُم بِأَمۡرِهِۦ يَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: La yasbiqoonahu bialqawli wahum biamrihi yaAAmaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command

ayahs.arabic: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يَشۡفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَتِهِۦ مُشۡفِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yashfaAAoona illa limani irtada wahum min khashyatihi mushfiqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَمَن يَقُلۡ مِنۡهُمۡ إِنِّيٓ إِلَٰهࣱ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waman yaqul minhum innee ilahun min doonihi fathalika najzeehi jahannama kathalika najzee alththalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ كَانَتَا رَتۡقࣰ ا فَفَتَقۡنَٰهُمَاۖ وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلۡمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ حَيٍّۚ أَفَلَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma wajaAAalna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجࣰ ا سُبُلࣰ ا لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: WajaAAalna fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim wajaAAalna feeha fijajan subulan laAAallahum yahtadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقۡفࣰ ا مَّحۡفُوظࣰ اۖ وَهُمۡ عَنۡ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.translit: WajaAAalna alssamaa saqfan mahfoothan wahum AAan ayatiha muAAridoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلࣱّ فِي فَلَكࣲ يَسۡبَحُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا لِبَشَرࣲ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ ٱلۡخُلۡدَۖ أَفَإِيْن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wama jaAAalna libasharin min qablika alkhulda afain mitta fahumu alkhalidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal

ayahs.arabic: كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۗ وَنَبۡلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلۡخَيۡرِ فِتۡنَةࣰۖ وَإِلَيۡنَا تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wanablookum bialshsharri waalkhayri fitnatan wailayna turjaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَذۡكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waitha raaka allatheena kafaroo in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee yathkuru alihatakum wahum bithikri alrrahmani hum kafiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers

ayahs.arabic: خُلِقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِنۡ عَجَلࣲۚ سَأُوْرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِي فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
ayahs.translit: Khuliqa alinsanu min AAajalin saoreekum ayatee fala tastaAAjiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful

ayahs.arabic: لَوۡ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Law yaAAlamu allatheena kafaroo heena la yakuffoona AAan wujoohihimu alnnara wala AAan thuhoorihim wala hum yunsaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ تَأۡتِيهِم بَغۡتَةࣰ فَتَبۡهَتُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Bal tateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum fala yastateeAAoona raddaha wala hum yuntharoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلࣲ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ مَن يَكۡلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qul man yaklaokum biallayli waalnnahari mina alrrahmani bal hum AAan thikri rabbihim muAAridoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ ءَالِهَةࣱ تَمۡنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَاۚ لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصۡحَبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am lahum alihatun tamnaAAuhum min doonina la yastateeAAoona nasra anfusihim wala hum minna yushaboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡعُمُرُۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَنَّا نَأۡتِي ٱلۡأَرۡضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنۡ أَطۡرَافِهَآۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Bal mattaAAna haolai waabaahum hatta tala AAalayhimu alAAumuru afala yarawna anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha afahumu alghaliboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلۡوَحۡيِۚ وَلَا يَسۡمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qul innama onthirukum bialwahyi wala yasmaAAu alssummu aldduAAaa itha ma yuntharoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned

ayahs.arabic: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةࣱ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Walain massathum nafhatun min AAathabi rabbika layaqoolunna ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: وَنَضَعُ ٱلۡمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلۡقِسۡطَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسࣱ شَيۡـࣰٔ اۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةࣲ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ أَتَيۡنَا بِهَاۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ
ayahs.translit: WanadaAAu almawazeena alqista liyawmi alqiyamati fala tuthlamu nafsun shayan wain kana mithqala habbatin min khardalin atayna biha wakafa bina hasibeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانَ وَضِيَآءࣰ وَذِكۡرࣰ ا لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad atayna moosa waharoona alfurqana wadiyaan wathikran lilmuttaqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشۡفِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi wahum mina alssaAAati mushfiqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive

ayahs.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ذِكۡرࣱ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُۚ أَفَأَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wahatha thikrun mubarakun anzalnahu afaantum lahu munkiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ رُشۡدَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad atayna ibraheema rushdahu min qablu wakunna bihi AAalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنتُمۡ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma hathihi alttamatheelu allatee antum laha AAakifoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo wajadna abaana laha AAabideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدۡ كُنتُمۡ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Qala laqad kuntum antum waabaokum fee dalalin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَجِئۡتَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ أَمۡ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo ajitana bialhaqqi am anta mina allaAAibeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمۡ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala bal rabbukum rabbu alssamawati waalardi allathee fatarahunna waana AAala thalikum mina alshshahideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify

ayahs.arabic: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصۡنَٰمَكُم بَعۡدَ أَن تُوَلُّواْ مُدۡبِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: WataAllahi laakeedanna asnamakum baAAda an tuwalloo mudbireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [I swear] by Allah, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرࣰ ا لَّهُمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: FajaAAalahum juthathan illa kabeeran lahum laAAallahum ilayhi yarjiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question]

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo man faAAala hatha bialihatina innahu lamina alththalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ سَمِعۡنَا فَتࣰ ى يَذۡكُرُهُمۡ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo samiAAna fatan yathkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibraheemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ فَأۡتُواْ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَشۡهَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo fatoo bihi AAala aAAyuni alnnasi laAAallahum yashhadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلۡتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo aanta faAAalta hatha bialihatina ya ibraheemu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ بَلۡ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمۡ هَٰذَا فَسۡـَٔلُوهُمۡ إِن كَانُواْ يَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala bal faAAalahu kabeeruhum hatha faisaloohum in kanoo yantiqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak

ayahs.arabic: فَرَجَعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: FarajaAAoo ila anfusihim faqaloo innakum antumu alththalimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ نُكِسُواْ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Thumma nukisoo AAala ruoosihim laqad AAalimta ma haolai yantiqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَفَتَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمۡ
ayahs.translit: Qala afataAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAukum shayan wala yadurrukum

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you

ayahs.arabic: أُفࣲّ لَّكُمۡ وَلِمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Offin lakum walima taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi afala taAAqiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah. Then will you not use reason

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo harriqoohu waonsuroo alihatakum in kuntum faAAileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِي بَرۡدࣰ ا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.translit: Qulna ya naru koonee bardan wasalaman AAala ibraheema

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham

ayahs.arabic: وَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدࣰ ا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alakhsareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers

ayahs.arabic: وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّتِي بَٰرَكۡنَا فِيهَا لِلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wanajjaynahu walootan ila alardi allatee barakna feeha lilAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds

ayahs.arabic: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ نَافِلَةࣰۖ وَكُلࣰّ ا جَعَلۡنَا صَٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba nafilatan wakullan jaAAalna saliheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَئِمَّةࣰ يَهۡدُونَ بِأَمۡرِنَا وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمۡ فِعۡلَ ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: WajaAAalnahum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina waawhayna ilayhim fiAAla alkhayrati waiqama alssalati waeetaa alzzakati wakanoo lana AAabideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us

ayahs.arabic: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمࣰ ا وَعِلۡمࣰ ا وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ ٱلَّتِي كَانَت تَّعۡمَلُ ٱلۡخَبَٰٓئِثَۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمَ سَوۡءࣲ فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Walootan ataynahu hukman waAAilman wanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatee kanat taAAmalu alkhabaitha innahum kanoo qawma sawin fasiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient

ayahs.arabic: وَأَدۡخَلۡنَٰهُ فِي رَحۡمَتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waadkhalnahu fee rahmatina innahu mina alssaliheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous

ayahs.arabic: وَنُوحًا إِذۡ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Wanoohan ith nada min qablu faistajabna lahu fanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood

ayahs.arabic: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمَ سَوۡءࣲ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wanasarnahu mina alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawma sawin faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together

ayahs.arabic: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ إِذۡ يَحۡكُمَانِ فِي ٱلۡحَرۡثِ إِذۡ نَفَشَتۡ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكۡمِهِمۡ شَٰهِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wadawooda wasulaymana ith yahkumani fee alharthi ith nafashat feehi ghanamu alqawmi wakunna lihukmihim shahideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement

ayahs.arabic: فَفَهَّمۡنَٰهَا سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيۡنَا حُكۡمࣰ ا وَعِلۡمࣰ اۚ وَسَخَّرۡنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلۡجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحۡنَ وَٱلطَّيۡرَۚ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fafahhamnaha sulaymana wakullan atayna hukman waAAilman wasakhkharna maAAa dawooda aljibala yusabbihna waalttayra wakunna faAAileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We gave understanding of the case to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that]

ayahs.arabic: وَعَلَّمۡنَٰهُ صَنۡعَةَ لَبُوسࣲ لَّكُمۡ لِتُحۡصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأۡسِكُمۡۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُمۡ شَٰكِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: WaAAallamnahu sanAAata laboosin lakum lituhsinakum min basikum fahal antum shakiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful

ayahs.arabic: وَلِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةࣰ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلَّتِي بَٰرَكۡنَا فِيهَاۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Walisulaymana alrreeha AAasifatan tajree biamrihi ila alardi allatee barakna feeha wakunna bikulli shayin AAalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعۡمَلُونَ عَمَلࣰ ا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wamina alshshayateeni man yaghoosoona lahu wayaAAmaloona AAamalan doona thalika wakunna lahum hafitheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَأَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alddurru waanta arhamu alrrahimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرࣲّۖ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡعَٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faistajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durrin waataynahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan min AAindina wathikra lilAAabideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah]

ayahs.arabic: وَإِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدۡرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ كُلࣱّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.translit: WaismaAAeela waidreesa watha alkifli kullun mina alssabireena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient

ayahs.arabic: وَأَدۡخَلۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waadkhalnahum fee rahmatina innahum mina alssaliheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous

ayahs.arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبࣰ ا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Watha alnnooni ith thahaba mughadiban fathanna an lan naqdira AAalayhi fanada fee alththulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina alththalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faistajabna lahu wanajjaynahu mina alghammi wakathalika nunjee almumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers

ayahs.arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرۡنِي فَرۡدࣰ ا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wazakariyya ith nada rabbahu rabbi la tatharnee fardan waanta khayru alwaritheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥ يَحۡيَىٰ وَأَصۡلَحۡنَا لَهُۥ زَوۡجَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَيَدۡعُونَنَا رَغَبࣰ ا وَرَهَبࣰ اۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا خَٰشِعِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faistajabna lahu wawahabna lahu yahya waaslahna lahu zawjahu innahum kanoo yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wayadAAoonana raghaban warahaban wakanoo lana khashiAAeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلۡنَٰهَا وَٱبۡنَهَآ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feeha min roohina wajaAAalnaha waibnaha ayatan lilAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ
ayahs.translit: Inna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faoAAbudooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me

ayahs.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيۡنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: WataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum kullun ilayna rajiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنࣱ فَلَا كُفۡرَانَ لِسَعۡيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala kufrana lisaAAyihi wainna lahu katiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders

ayahs.arabic: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآ أَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waharamun AAala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarjiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتۡ يَأۡجُوجُ وَمَأۡجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبࣲ يَنسِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Hatta itha futihat yajooju wamajooju wahum min kulli hadabin yansiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend

ayahs.arabic: وَٱقۡتَرَبَ ٱلۡوَعۡدُ ٱلۡحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَٰخِصَةٌ أَبۡصَٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا قَدۡ كُنَّا فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا بَلۡ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waiqtaraba alwaAAdu alhaqqu faitha hiya shakhisatun absaru allatheena kafaroo ya waylana qad kunna fee ghaflatin min hatha bal kunna thalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكُمۡ وَمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمۡ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Innakum wama taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it

ayahs.arabic: لَوۡ كَانَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةࣰ مَّا وَرَدُوهَاۖ وَكُلࣱّ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Law kana haolai alihatan ma waradooha wakullun feeha khalidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein

ayahs.arabic: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا زَفِيرࣱ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Lahum feeha zafeerun wahum feeha la yasmaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتۡ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَنۡهَا مُبۡعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna allatheena sabaqat lahum minna alhusna olaika AAanha mubAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَاۖ وَهُمۡ فِي مَا ٱشۡتَهَتۡ أَنفُسُهُمۡ خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: La yasmaAAoona haseesaha wahum fee ma ishtahat anfusuhum khalidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَحۡزُنُهُمُ ٱلۡفَزَعُ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوۡمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: La yahzunuhumu alfazaAAu alakbaru watatalaqqahumu almalaikatu hatha yawmukumu allathee kuntum tooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِي ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَيِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلۡكُتُبِۚ كَمَا بَدَأۡنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلۡقࣲ نُّعِيدُهُۥۚ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Yawma natwee alssamaa katayyi alssijlli lilkutubi kama badana awwala khalqin nuAAeeduhu waAAdan AAalayna inna kunna faAAileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ كَتَبۡنَا فِي ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ أَنَّ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad katabna fee alzzaboori min baAAdi alththikri anna alarda yarithuha AAibadiya alssalihoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغࣰ ا لِّقَوۡمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna fee hatha labalaghan liqawmin AAabideena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحۡمَةࣰ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Wama arsalnaka illa rahmatan lilAAalameena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهࣱ وَٰحِدࣱۖ فَهَلۡ أَنتُم مُّسۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qul innama yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]

ayahs.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقُلۡ ءَاذَنتُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءࣲۖ وَإِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fain tawallaw faqul athantukum AAala sawain wain adree aqareebun am baAAeedun ma tooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَكۡتُمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Innahu yaAAlamu aljahra mina alqawli wayaAAlamu ma taktumoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنۡ أَدۡرِي لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتۡنَةࣱ لَّكُمۡ وَمَتَٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Wain adree laAAallahu fitnatun lakum wamataAAun ila heenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time

ayahs.arabic: قَٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ٱلۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi ohkum bialhaqqi warabbuna alrrahmanu almustaAAanu AAala ma tasifoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe
